create_file_from_text.description: Save text as a new file in Drive, such as a summary, a note or a log, as a plain text file or a Google Doc, and return a link to it.
create_file_from_text.name: create_file_from_text

parameters.description: The new file's name. For a text file, end it in .txt so it opens as one.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What to put in the file.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: The Google Drive folder to put it in. Leave blank for My Drive.
parameters.name: folder_url

parameters.description: Turn on to make a Google Doc instead of a plain text file.
parameters.name: as_google_doc

file_id.description: Its id, for a Google Docs step when it's a Google Doc

file_link.description: A link to the new file

create_folder.description: Create a folder and return a link to it.
create_folder.name: create_folder

parameters.description: The name of the folder to create.
parameters.name: folder_name

parameters.description: The folder to create the new folder in: pick one, or paste its link. Leave empty for the top of My Drive.
parameters.name: parent_folder_url

parameters.description: Beta. Turn on to get the link to a folder with this name that is already there, instead of making a second one, such as one folder per customer or sender.
parameters.display_name: Use the folder if it already exists
parameters.name: reuse_existing

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "folder_link" field.

folder_link.description: A link to the created folder

delete_file.description: Move a file to the Google Drive trash. It can be restored from the trash for 30 days, after which Google deletes it for good.
delete_file.name: delete_file

parameters.description: The Google Drive URL of the file to move to the trash.
parameters.name: file_url

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "deleted" field.

deleted.description: Whether the file was moved to the trash

download_file_from_url.description: Save a copy of a Drive file, from its link, for later steps to attach or upload elsewhere. To use its text instead, use Read file.
download_file_from_url.name: download_file_from_url

parameters.description: The sharing URL of the Google Drive file.
parameters.name: file_url

document_ref.description: The saved file, to pass to a later step that takes a file (an email attachment, an AI step's files).

duplicate_file.description: Duplicate a file in its own folder and return a link to the duplicate.
duplicate_file.name: duplicate_file

parameters.description: The Google Drive URL of the file to duplicate.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: The folder to put the copy in: pick one, or paste its link. Leave empty to keep it beside the original.
parameters.name: destination_folder_url

parameters.description: The name for the copy.
parameters.name: new_name

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "duplicate_link" field.

duplicate_link.description: A link to the duplicated file

export_file.description: Save a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides presentation as a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV or text file, for later steps to attach or upload elsewhere. Up to 10 MB. For files that aren't Google files, use Download file.
export_file.name: export_file

parameters.description: The Google Drive link of the Google Doc, Sheet or Slides presentation.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: The kind of file to make. A Doc can be a PDF, Word or text file; a Sheet a PDF, Excel or CSV file (its first tab); a presentation a PDF, PowerPoint or text file.
parameters.name: file_format

document_ref.description: The saved file, to pass to a later step that takes a file (an email attachment, an AI step's files).

list_access.description: List everyone who can open a file or folder, and what each can do: people, groups, a whole organization, or anyone with the link.
list_access.name: list_access

parameters.description: The Google Drive link of the file or folder.
parameters.name: file_url

access.description: owner, can edit, can comment or can view

inherited.description: True when it comes from a shared drive or a folder above

who.description: Their email, or Anyone with the link

move_file.description: Move a file to a different folder.
move_file.name: move_file

parameters.description: The Google Drive URL of the file to move.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: The folder to move the file to: pick one, or paste its link.
parameters.name: destination_folder_url

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "file_link" field.

file_link.description: A link to the moved file

read_file.description: Read the text of a Google Doc, presentation, spreadsheet's first tab, PDF, Word document or text file, so later steps can use it. Use a link from Search files or a sharing link. Does not change the file. To keep the file itself, use Download file. Up to 10 MB. A long text is read in parts: to read on, run it again from where it stopped.
read_file.name: read_file

parameters.description: File link from Search files or a Google Drive sharing link.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: Maximum characters to return, from 1 to 100000. Only the first 30,000 are read unless you raise this, so set 100000 when something needs the whole of a long document, such as a contract to summarise.
parameters.name: max_chars

parameters.description: Where in the text to start reading, as a character count. To read on, use where an earlier read stopped.
parameters.name: offset

remove_access.description: Stop someone being able to open a file or folder, by their email address, or turn off link sharing, or both. Someone who has no access already is left as they are. The owner can't be removed.
remove_access.name: remove_access

parameters.description: The Google Drive link of the file or folder.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: The email address of the person or group to remove. Leave blank to only turn off link sharing.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Turn on to also stop anyone with the link opening it.
parameters.name: link_sharing

removed.description: Whose access was removed; empty when they had none

rename_file.description: Give a file or folder a new name.
rename_file.name: rename_file

parameters.description: The Google Drive link of the file or folder to rename.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: The new name, with the file's ending if it has one (such as .pdf).
parameters.name: new_name

file_link.description: A link to the renamed file or folder

replace_file.description: Upload new contents for a file already in Drive, keeping its name, link, sharing and folder; Drive keeps the old contents as an earlier version. For uploaded files such as PDFs and Word documents, not Google Docs, Sheets or Slides.
replace_file.name: replace_file

parameters.description: The Google Drive link of the file to replace.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: The file with the new contents, chosen with the file picker or from an earlier step.
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.description: The new file's format, for example 'application/pdf'. Leave blank to keep the file's own type.
parameters.name: mime_type

file_link.description: A link to the file, the same as before

search_files.description: Find files by words in their names or indexed contents, across My Drive and shared drives. No file link is needed. Returns file names and links; use Read file to answer questions from their contents. Gets one page; to see more, run it again with the next page it gives.
search_files.name: search_files

parameters.description: Words to find in file names or contents. All words must match. Leave empty to list recent files.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The folder to search only the files directly in: pick one, or paste its link. Leave empty to search across Drive.
parameters.name: folder_url

parameters.description: Files per page, from 1 to 100.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: The next page an earlier search with the same words gave, to see more results.
parameters.name: page_token

incomplete_search.description: True when Drive could not search every shared drive. Narrow to a folder before claiming no matching files exist.

next_page_token.description: Empty when there are no more pages.

share_by_link.description: Let anyone with the link open a file or folder, and get the link to send. The file doesn't show up in searches. Some organizations don't allow sharing outside them; Google then refuses.
share_by_link.display_str_template: Share '{0}' with anyone who has the link ({access}).
share_by_link.name: share_by_link

parameters.description: The Google Drive link of the file or folder to share.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: What anyone with the link can do with it.
parameters.name: access

access.description: What they can do: view, comment or edit

link.description: The link to send: anyone with it can open the file

share_file.description: Give someone access to a file or folder by their email address. Sharing a folder shares everything in it.
share_file.name: share_file

parameters.description: The Google Drive link of the file or folder to share.
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.description: The email address of the person to share with.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: What they can do with it.
parameters.name: access

parameters.description: Send them Google's email saying it was shared. Turn off to share without telling them; someone without a Google account can only be shared with by email.
parameters.name: notify

access.description: What they can do: view, comment or edit

link.description: A link to the shared file or folder, to send to the person

upload_file.description: Upload a file to Drive and return a link to it.
upload_file.name: upload_file

parameters.description: The file to upload: upload one here, or use a file an earlier step saved, by giving that step's document_ref (such as the document_ref from PandaDoc's 'Download a document' or an email attachment). Despite the name, this is not a path on a computer or a link.
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.description: The folder to upload the file to: pick one, or paste its link. Left out, the file goes to the top of My Drive, so when the request names a folder ("our contracts folder") write this as "" and the person is asked to pick it.
parameters.name: folder_url

parameters.description: What to call the file in Drive, with its ending, such as Acme contract (signed).pdf. Leave empty to keep the file's own name.
parameters.name: file_name

returns.description: Response envelope; the payload is in the "upload_link" field.

upload_link.description: A link to the uploaded file

description: Search, read, upload, and manage files in Google Drive.

google_drive_new_file_trigger.description: Runs when a new file is added to Google Drive.

parameters.description: The Google Drive folder ID to watch. Leave blank to watch your whole Drive.
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.description: Only trigger for files of this MIME type (e.g. application/pdf). Leave blank to match any type.
parameters.name: mime_type

parameters.description: Only trigger for files whose name contains this text. Leave blank to match any file.
parameters.name: name_pattern

google_drive_updated_file_trigger.description: Runs when a file in Google Drive is changed: edited, replaced or renamed.

parameters.description: The Google Drive folder ID to watch. Leave blank to watch your whole Drive.
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.description: Only trigger for files of this MIME type (e.g. application/pdf). Leave blank to match any type.
parameters.name: mime_type

parameters.description: Only trigger for files whose name contains this text. Leave blank to match any file.
parameters.name: name_pattern
